children: Indonesia exported 13.51 million metric tons of crude and refined palm oil in the January-to-July period, down 0.97% from the same period a year earlier, statistics bureau data showed on Tuesday.
The shipments were valued at $14.79 billion, up 5.49% from the first seven months of 2025.

The bureau's data excludes palm kernel oil, oleochemicals and biodiesel. GAPKI, Indonesia's palm oil association, usually releases its own numbers at a later date, covering more products, and thus has different export figures.
